faq1a: Yes. No account or application installation is required. Download availability depends on the source and the service’s limits.
faq2a: Individual video links from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and X are recognized. Recognition is not a guarantee of access. YouTube access on our hosting is currently blocked by the provider’s anti-bot checks.
faq3q: Can I download private or restricted videos?
faq3a: No. Login restrictions, private accounts, deleted posts and geographic restrictions are not bypassed.
faq4a: Files stream to your browser rather than being permanently kept. Temporary metadata, transfer statuses and limited quota records help run the service. See the privacy policy.
faq5q: How do I save audio as MP3?
faq5a: Analyze an accessible authorized link, choose the Audio tab and select MP3 if available. Converting audio does not improve the original recording.
faq6a: Output is limited to 256 MiB, declared media duration to 30 minutes and each operation to 10 minutes. One operation runs at a time; quotas and a bounded queue also apply.
faq7a: Only save content you own, that is appropriately licensed, or that you have permission to download. Public visibility alone does not give you that permission. Follow local law and platform rules.
legalDescription: Terms of use, privacy policy and abuse reporting for the VidFetch video and audio download service.
legalIntro: By using VidFetch, you agree to use the service responsibly and follow the terms below.
notice1: VidFetch is an automated media analysis and download service at vidfetch.app. Contact the operator at legal@vidfetch.io.
notice2: VidFetch is not affiliated with YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Meta or X. Their names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
notice3: The service is provided as available. Access, formats and speed depend on the source and hosting. No download is guaranteed.
terms1: Only download your own content, appropriately licensed content, or content you have the rights holder’s permission to save. Public visibility does not grant downloading or redistribution rights.
terms2: Follow applicable law, copyright and platform terms. Do not bypass access controls or redistribute protected material without permission.
terms3: Private, deleted, age-restricted, login-required or region-restricted content may be unavailable. VidFetch does not override these restrictions.
terms4: Automated abuse, excessive requests, overload attempts and unauthorized access are prohibited. Concurrency and quotas are limited to protect availability.
terms5: Media belongs to its creators and rights holders. VidFetch claims no ownership of downloaded content.
privacy1: No VidFetch account is required. The application does not use advertising cookies or third-party advertising trackers.
privacy2: Media streams through bounded buffers and is not permanently saved as a media file on the server. Metadata and source URLs may be cached in memory for up to five minutes.
privacy3: Temporary statuses and bounded quota records prevent abuse. IP-based quota identifiers are keyed hashes. Raw links and titles are not intentionally logged by the gateway. Legacy database features, if enabled, may record metadata. Do not submit confidential links.
privacy4: Unused tickets expire after one minute. Transfer status remains in memory for up to thirty minutes. Infrastructure may maintain operational logs.
privacy5: Secure downloads use short-lived authorization cookies and a verification challenge for access control, not advertising. The isolated engine rejects platform cookies and does not bypass login restrictions.
privacy6: For questions about stored metadata or deletion requests, contact privacy@vidfetch.io and identify the relevant URL or transfer.
report1: Report abuse or copyright concerns to abuse@vidfetch.io with the original URL, a description and evidence of your rights or authority.
report2: VidFetch does not host a permanent media copy. Ask the source platform to remove the original; VidFetch’s operator can review service access and stored operational metadata.
